text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Engine start.
Front clear. Release brakes.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's endless...
The summit goes on forever, far, far into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Freed from everything, reaching solely for the heights.
Ah, this is the true bliss of the 'sky'...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch, almost time for training, huh?
Then again—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"What I need right now
isn't to struggle on the ground."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Further, even further ahead.
I want to see what lies beyond, at the edge of this sky.
That is precisely what I need right now!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm flying one more time.
Next time, even higher—!

So thoroughly enjoying the flight in a light aircraft,
she ended up slacking off on training...
